_setup: Copy this whole directory and pr-steward.json and pr-steward.meta.json into your repository's .pi/taskflows/, rename this file to config.json, and list your repositories. The flow needs pi-taskflow installed in the host: pi install npm:pi-taskflow.
_comment_repos: Every repository the flow looks in for open bot dependency upgrades, as owner/name.
_comment_botAuthors: The bot authors to discover, as gh --author values. Omit the key to get the default, ["app/dependabot"]. An empty array means no authors, so nothing is discovered.
